shots.brief: warming up or stretching before a workout (ref: Woman stretching her shoulders with a red resistance band in a dim gym, then rolling it up and adjusting her oversized hoodie; tripod)
running on a treadmill or track (ref: Low angle tracking shot of running on a gym treadmill; tripod)
taking off warm-up layers or tying athletic shoes (ref: Low-angle shot in a locker room stripping off sweatpants before a workout; tripod)
cycling or cardio exercise machine (ref: Rear view of woman pedaling on a stationary spin bike; tripod)
POV climbing stairs or stairmaster (ref: POV looking down at feet climbing steps on a stairmaster; POV)

audit.notes: Perfect format for any fitness, climbing, or self-improvement b-roll library. Pair 1 longer contemplative shot (stretching/chalking up) with 6-7 rapid 0.5-second cuts of intense training (bouldering, hangboard, lifting, running).
audit.summary: A fitness motivation reel contrasting casual procrastination thoughts with the regret of not starting earlier, set over a montage of gym training clips.
